data.name: Adeena
data.gender_notes: Adeena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'din', meaning 'religion', this name evokes the idea of a precious, adorned one in the religious context. The name Adeena carries the meaning “Adorned, precious one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adeena usually hope their child will grow to embody adorned, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Adeena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adorned, precious one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adeena total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
